usedFor: LiveChat holds visitor conversations, and MailerLite receives people as subscribers through “Create or Update Subscriber” when “Finished Chat” fires.

bestTemplate.name: “Finished Chat” in LiveChat, then “Create or Update Subscriber” in MailerLite
bestTemplate.why: A finished chat adds or updates that person as a MailerLite subscriber for later emails.

watchOut: “New Chat” fires when a chat starts and “Finished Chat” when it ends, so pick your moment.
